profile.headline: Professional Tech Videos from a Developers Perspective. Scott Lee is an American award-winning video game, television, and film score composer.
profile.summary: Sharp, dedicated business professional with long-standing and diverse experience throughout multiple industries. Deadline driven with outstanding organizational and multi-tasking skills. Proactive team leader with a strong ability to also work independently.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed, developed, and maintained internal Web based  HIIPA compliant system for secure inventory control of client submitted assets. Utilized ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI with a SQL Server backend database for patient records.

positions.title: Senior Sound Designer, Audio Director
positions.description: Team leader adding samples & music to SourceSafe, applying level sound placements within the native scripting language, implementing seamless audio tools designs for better development within Nile, the proprietary design software.

positions.title: Audio Director, Song Composer, Engineer
positions.description: Supervisor of all audio placements, unique audio scores, voice over dialogue, dialogue coaching, foley sessions, level ambience,  and mastering finished products for the Playstation 2 console franchise.

positions.title: Senior Sound Designer, Song Composer, Engineer
positions.description: Cinematic compositions, engineering, immersive soundscapes, foley effects, vocal coaching, engineering, scripting, and mastering final productions. All early audio development helped secure a long term partnership with THQ.

positions.title: Technical Specialist, Web Designer
positions.description: Hardware & Software evaluation for mass production approval for the engineering and support divisions. Executed web designs for all outgoing media based productions.
